cases.description: Senior AI engineer resume vs. a well-matched Staff AI Engineer JD - should shortlist.
cases.resume_text: John Doe. 6 years of experience building production LangGraph multi-agent systems in Python. Deployed on AWS with Docker containers. Built RAG pipelines backed by Pinecone vector search and wrote extensive integration tests for each release.
cases.job_description: We are hiring a Staff AI Engineer with 5+ years of experience in Python, LangGraph, AWS, Docker, and Vector Databases. You will own our agentic AI platform end to end.
cases.notes: 4/5 required skills present exactly (Pinecone is a vector DB but is not the literal string 'Vector Databases', so exact-match scoring counts it as 4/5 = 0.80); experience 6.0 >= 5.0. 0.80 >= 0.50 and 6.0 >= 5.0 -> ShortList.

cases.description: Frontend-heavy resume against a backend-heavy JD - should reject on skill match despite ample experience.
cases.resume_text: Jane Smith. 7 years building React and JavaScript single-page apps with CSS and HTML, plus some Node.js tooling for internal dashboards.
cases.job_description: Seeking a backend engineer with strong Java, Spring Boot, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, and Kafka experience. 4+ years required.
cases.notes: 0/5 skill overlap -> skill_match 0.00 < 0.50 threshold; rejects regardless of the 7.0 >= 4.0 experience being sufficient.

cases.description: Full skill overlap but candidate has too little experience for a senior role - should reject on the experience gate.
cases.resume_text: Alex Kim. 1.5 years of professional experience. Built small internal tools using Python, SQL, AWS Lambda, and Docker.
cases.job_description: Senior Platform Engineer, 6+ years required. Must know Python, SQL, AWS, and Docker.
cases.notes: Skill match is 4/4 = 1.00 but experience 1.5 < 6.0 -> Reject. Verifies the AND-gate: a perfect skill score alone is not enough.

cases.description: Skill match lands exactly on the 0.50 boundary with sufficient experience - regression guard for the >= operator.
cases.resume_text: Priya Nair. 5 years building cloud infrastructure with Python and AWS, plus Redis caching and GraphQL APIs.
cases.job_description: DevOps Engineer, 5+ years, must have Python, AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes.
cases.notes: 2/4 = 0.50 exactly. CheckCriteria uses >= 0.50, so this case must ShortList - catches a > vs >= regression if the threshold operator ever changes.
